IEEE Transactions on Multimedia 2026 | ULightIF

ULightIF: Unsupervised Low Light Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Method

## 🙌 1 Introduction * This is the official implementation of our paper titled "ULightIF: Unsupervised Low Light Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Method". This paper has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia. * If you have any question about this code, feel free to reach me(cmuhang@163.com) ## 🌐 2 Prepare Your Dataset Please download the datasets from the following links: [MSRS](https://github.com/Linfeng-Tang/MSRS) | [LLVIP](https://bupt-ai-cz.github.io/LLVIP/) | [M3FD](https://github.com/dlut-dimt/TarDAL). Download the corresponding datasets following their official instructions, and then modify the dataset paths in the `options.py` configuration file. ## 🛠️ 3 Pretrained Weights The weight files released in the `weights` directory are the original paper checkpoints used by `test_p.py`. ## 🚀 4 Usage To facilitate the open-source release, we refactored the codebase using PyTorch Lightning, improving readability and maintainability. Accordingly, this repository provides two testing scripts: - `test_p.py`: reproduces the results in the paper. - `test.py`: evaluates models trained with the refactored training pipeline. Users may select either the intermediate fusion result or the final enhanced result for comparison, depending on whether the task targets standard or low-light image fusion. ### 📖 4.1 Training Before training, please download and prepare the dataset and configure the training settings in `options.py`. Then run: ```bash python train.py ``` ### 🧩 4.2 Testing To reproduce the results reported in the paper, run: ```bash python test_p.py ``` To test your own trained model, run: ```bash python test.py ``` ## ❤️ Citation If you find our work useful for your research, please cite our paper. ``` @ARTICLE{cheng2026ulight, author={Cheng, Muhang and Huang, Haiyan and Mo, Hongwei}, journal={IEEE Transactions on Multimedia}, title={ULightIF: Unsupervised Low Light Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Method}, year={2026}, volume={}, number={}, pages={1-13}, doi={10.1109/TMM.2026.3723605}} ``` ## Related Work ``` @ARTICLE{11673287, author={Cheng, Muhang and Mo, Hongwei}, journal={IEEE Transactions on Multimedia}, title={SpikeVFuse: Enhancing Infrared and Visible Image Fusion with Spiking Neural Networks}, year={2026}, volume={}, number={}, pages={1-13}, doi={10.1109/TMM.2026.3729390}} @ARTICLE{cheng2025fdfuse, author={Cheng, Muhang and Huang, Haiyan and Liu, Xiangyu and Mo, Hongwei and Wu, Songling and Zhao, Xiongbo}, journal={IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement}, title={FDFuse: Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Based on Feature Decomposition}, year={2025}, volume={74}, number={}, pages={1-13}, doi={10.1109/TIM.2025.3551460}} @article{cheng2025lefuse, title={LEFuse: Joint low-light enhancement and image fusion for nighttime infrared and visible images}, author={Cheng, Muhang and Huang, Haiyan and Liu, Xiangyu and Mo, Hongwei and Zhao, Xiongbo and Wu, Songling}, journal={Neurocomputing}, volume={626}, pages={129592}, year={2025}, publisher={Elsevier} } ``` ## Acknowledgements This repository is mainly built upon [MobileIE](MobileIE). We thank the authors for their well-organized codebases.
